content.text:
Perfect! All 105 tests pass ✓

**Created src/dates.js with UTC date operations:**
- `isValidDate(text)` — validates YYYY-MM-DD format and real dates
- `addDays(date, n)` — adds n days in UTC, returns YYYY-MM-DD
- `daysBetween(a, b)` — calculates b - a in whole days

**Updated createInvoice** to use centralized `isValidDate` from dates module

**Tests cover:**
- Valid/invalid date formats
- Nonexistent dates (Feb 30, etc.)
- Leap year handling (2024-02-29)
- Positive/negative day additions
- Month and year boundary transitions
- Positive/negative date differences
- Inverse property (addDays + daysBetween)

All operations strictly use UTC, never local timezone.
